Hi Hannah,

We're trying to finish registration in your supplier portal but ran into two things that will block our integration test:

1) The MSA sent via DocuSign has a couple of redlines from our legal team (data retention term and invoice remit). Can you confirm who on your side will review counter-redlines?

2) Our system's PO XML doesn't include a buyerCode element by default — we usually put remit/billing info under <BillTo>. When we imported the sample PO from your portal it failed validation; the portal is expecting a buyerCode/billTo mapping.

I'm attaching the sample PO we used and the initial order form we received from your sales rep for reference.

Attachments: [sample_po.xml (xml)], [initial_orderform.pdf (pdf)]

We can provide a PO with buyerCode if that's the easiest fix, but would prefer to avoid custom transforms if your portal can map BillTo -> BuyerCode.

Quick ask: can you loop in legal + onboarding ops and let me know whether: (a) your legal will sign our minor MSA tweaks, and (b) ops can accept BillTo mapping or need buyerCode in XML?

Thanks —

Thanks for the ping, Hannah — looping in legal ops context below.

Quick read of the redlines:
- Data retention: MedSys asks for 5 years. Our standard is 7 years for audit logs but 5 years for customer content is acceptable if we document the retention scope (we'll keep telemetry/audit logs for 7). I can propose language: "Customer content will be retained for five (5) years post-termination; telemetry and audit logs retained up to seven (7) years."
- Invoice remit: they want remit address locked in the order form. We prefer remit to be defined in the order form but allow updates via written notice; propose: "Remit address as listed in the Order Form; updates require thirty (30) days' notice."

I've created a tracked redline and attached it as MSA_redline_v3.docx with suggested edits and a short cover note for commercial.

If legal approves these narrow changes, there's no material risk to our platform commitments. Mateo — when you have the mapping details, I'll incorporate the order form language so sales can sign off.

Soojin Lee

Hi all — ops perspective and a short checklist so MedSys can provision staging and avoid import errors:

Staging tenant: medsys-stg (we'll need a service account + SFTP credentials or API key)
Integration window: EDI ACK expected within 30 minutes of PO ingest (configurable)
Required PO fields (portal validation):
- PO_Number (string)
- Line_Item_ID (int)
- SKU (string)
- Quantity (int)
- Unit_Price (decimal)
- Currency (ISO3)
- BillTo/Remit (object) OR <BuyerCode> (string) — portal can accept either, but mapping is explicit. If you supply BillTo we will map BillTo/Remit -> BuyerCode provided you include a consistent identifier (e.g., TaxID or RemitID).

We have a simple mapping table attached (PO-field-mapping.xlsx) that shows the expected XML elements and examples. If you can provide one sample PO with a <BuyerCode> element we can mirror that in the mapping and accelerate validation.

Also: please confirm whether your environment needs TLS mutual auth for SFTP or if username/password is sufficient. For API integrations we support HMAC keys.

Next steps for MedSys:
- Provide sample_po_with_buyercode.xml OR confirm BillTo content (taxID/remitID)
- Tell us whether SFTP (mutual TLS) or API (HMAC)
- Procurement opens a ticket for staging credentials (we'll provision within 24 business hours once ticket is received)

Confluence reference: https://confluence.redwood.com/display/ONBOARD/MedSys+PO+Field+Mapping

Attachment: [PO-field-mapping.xlsx (xlsx)]

Thanks,
Mateo Alvarez
